name: Kukirin World V2
desc:
[🛴 ] - Welcome to Kukirin World V2!

Hop on your e-scooter and take over the city. Grind for cash, race strangers, pull wheelies, and build your rep from the bottom up. No handouts. Just hustle.

⚡ - Ride Kukirins, Surrons, mopeds & more.
💰 - Earn money, upgrade your ride, flex on the block.
🏁 - Race others in real-time across the map.
🛞 - Wheelies, tricks & pure bikelife energy.

Whether you're repping Kukirins, Surrons, Mopeds or anywhere in between the road is yours.

🔥 1,000+ riders already on the streets. Don't get left behind.
